description: Renovate opens all PRs against staging; nothing reaches main without Jon merging a release PR. Green minor/patch PRs auto-merge to staging. Majors and Playwright wait for the Sunday job.

packageRules.description: All non-major updates in one PR, merged automatically once CI is green
Majors get their own PR and are never auto-merged
A new Playwright version ships a new Chromium, which can change the visual baselines, so it always gets its own PR and is never auto-merged
